result.summary: Analysis identified two issues: a duplicate content error and text truncation in the horizontal scroll list.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant appears twice consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Update the feed logic to ensure unique restaurant entries per section.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' row has a truncated title that cuts off the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the text container size or font scaling to prevent truncation of vendor names.
